simple.meaning: Abihail or Abichail , the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲבִיהַיִל (H32) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲבִיהַיִל (ʼĂbîyhayil) means Abihail or Abichail , the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 29.

definitions.short: Abihail or Abichail , the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses
definitions.full: H32. Abihayil or Abichayil אֲבִיחַ֫יִל proper name, masculine & feminine ( my father is might , Sabean אבחיל Hal MA 234 ) — probably = אֲבִיהַיִל 2Chr 11:18 , אֲבִיהָ֑יִל 1Chr 2:29 — 1 a Levite Num 3:25 . 2 a Gadite 1Chr 5:14 . 3 father of Esther Est 2:15 ; 9:29 . 4 wife of Abishur 1Chr 2:29 . 5 wife of Rehoboam 2Chr 11:18 .
definitions.rootNote: or (more correctly) אֲבִיחַיִל ; from 1 and 2428 ; father (i.e. possessor) of might;
